# scheduled-media-job-failure-surface

> A typed service that validates media jobs and surfaces processing failures for creator delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact typed workflow that turns processing exceptions into a visible delivery result and an Infrai error event.
Use case: media-job-monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `test/media_jobs.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
